description: Example conversations showing how SKAI greets, informs, assists and represents your brand.

messages.text: Hello and welcome to SkyXHub! I’m SKAI. How can I help you today?
Hi SKAI! Can we talk in Arabic?
Of course! I can switch between Arabic, English, French, Hindi and Chinese anytime.
What does your B2B travel portal offer?
Multi-GDS and NDC content, real-time ticketing and reporting — all in one white-label portal.
Can I see it in action?
The keynote starts at 2:00 PM in Hall A — a 3-minute walk. Follow me and I’ll guide you.
Introducing our newest launch! Scan the code on my screen for an exclusive offer.
Nice — can you take a photo with me?
